created_at_note: Timestamp set from the current clock during post-creation validation; it is not an experiment start time.
purpose: Pre-run contract for the first formal selector-free VMem long-horizon baseline and any later GRC/SOCF comparison.

scope.formal_baseline: VMem selector-free baseline only after every required section is PASS
scope.method_scoring: GRC/SOCF scoring is prohibited by this contract until the baseline and independent held-out identity are frozen
scope.evidence_boundary: This file records qualification and protocol state; it contains no model prediction, future score, or method claim.

candidate_scene.name: TUM RGB-D Freiburg3 long office household

values.pixel_center_convention: integer pixel centers; raster index=floor(u+0.5), floor(v+0.5), bound to project S14E convention
values.transform_direction: TUM groundtruth camera-to-world; projection uses world_to_camera=R.T @ (X-t)

camera.blocking_reason: Camera intrinsics, distortion, pixel-center convention, and transform direction are not frozen for the formal selected source.

depth.blocking_reason: The sample dtype is known, but invalid-value handling, scale, and optical-axis/radial semantics are not frozen.

values.pairing_rule: strict abs(rgb_timestamp-depth_timestamp)<0.02, deterministic minimum absolute difference

rgb_depth_pairing.blocking_reason: A candidate 20 ms pairing was measured, but the deterministic one-to-one rule and complete drop/duplicate accounting are not frozen.

values.timestamp_or_frame_identity: timestamp seconds since Unix epoch; match to paired RGB timestamp, never frame index
values.quaternion_order: tx ty tz qx qy qz qw
values.transform_direction: camera-to-world; invert rigid transform for world-to-camera projection

pose.blocking_reason: Pose semantics and frame identity are not yet frozen; frame indices must not be treated as hardware timestamps.

future_gt_isolation.blocking_reason: The future query split and sealed scorer handoff have not been frozen.

values.cross_scene_role: independent held-out RGB-D scene; train sequences 1,2,4,6 for calibration/history and test sequences 3,5 for future evaluation

heldout_identity.blocking_reason: No independent zero-exposure held-out scene has been acquired and hashed. TUM and ICL-NUIM entries are development/conditional candidates.

values.candidate_pool_definition: fixed paired RGB-D history observations from declared train/test sequence window; no post-result selection
values.seed_and_rng_policy: seed=20260916; torch/numpy/python RNG recorded; same seed per paired condition
values.resolution: model native 224x224 input; evaluation at declared 640x480 depth
values.dtype: float32 model inputs; AMP disabled unless explicitly declared
values.selector_comparison_rule: same candidate pool, k, context, outputs, seed/RNG, resolution, dtype, and runtime budget

fair_budget.blocking_reason: The formal baseline and selector budgets are not frozen in a signed pre-run manifest.

checkpoints_and_code.blocking_reason: Checkpoint bytes and hashes are verified, but the exact source commit and formal config hash are not signed together with this run contract.

independent_readback.blocking_reason: The independent verifier and post-run seal are to be bound after the pre-run manifest is frozen.

acceptance.formal_baseline_can_start_only_if: every sections.<name>.status is PASS and formal_experiment_eligibility is explicitly changed to PASS in a new signed contract revision
acceptance.method_scoring_can_start_only_if: formal baseline is complete, future GT is isolated, and the same-pool fixed-budget comparison contract is independently reviewed

next_action: Bind sealed scorer and prediction hash before opening future frames; complete independent readback contract, then create a new PASS revision only if validator evidence supports it.
